msg: Hey! I got my Open Water certification 3 years ago but haven't dived since. I'm staying in Getsemaní for a week and would love to dive on two different days. What would you recommend and how much is it? Can I pay cash in dollars on the boat?
reply:
Hi! 🪸 I'm *Coral* from *Diving Planet* — we dive year-round in the Rosario Islands, departing from Cartagena or right from the islands. 🌊

That sounds like a lovely way to explore the Rosario Islands! Since it’s been 3 years since your last dive, a refresher is normally required. It’s booked as the Dive Mini Course, which includes a review with an instructor.

For two separate days, you could do the refresher on one day and certified Fun Dives on another. The 10% online discount is applied when booking through our website. The Fun Dives include two reef dives, equipment, lunch, and round-trip boat transport; both activities depart from Muelle de la Bodeguita.

Payment is made through the online booking link, so cash in dollars on the boat isn’t an option.

*Prices per person* (online · regular):
*From Cartagena*
• Fun Dives - 2 dives (1 day): 178 USD · 197 USD (630.000 COP · 700.000 COP)
• 4-dive package (2 days, 4 daytime dives): 316 USD · 351 USD (1.154.000 COP · 1.282.000 COP)
• Dive Mini Course: 183 USD · 204 USD (655.000 COP · 727.000 COP)
*Already on the Rosario Islands*
• Fun Dives - 2 dives (1 day): 124 USD · 138 USD (440.000 COP · 489.000 COP)
• 4-dive package (2 days, 4 daytime dives): 204 USD · 227 USD (720.000 COP · 800.000 COP)
• Dive Mini Course: 134 USD · 149 USD (475.000 COP · 528.000 COP)

So, would you leave *from Cartagena* (Muelle de la Bodeguita)? 🚤

msg: Yes, from Cartagena. I'm German by the way. So what's the plan, the refresher on day one and normal dives on day two? Does the refresher day include lunch too?
reply:
Yes, that plan works: you can do the refresher on one day and regular certified dives on another. The refresher includes pool practice and one reef dive with a PADI instructor, plus lunch at the island hotel facilities. It also includes the park entrance fee, mandatory dive insurance, round-trip boat transport, equipment, and an eco-social contribution to DIVE TO HEAL.

The refresher meeting point is Muelle de la Bodeguita at 8:00 a.m.; ground transportation to the dock isn’t included. The return to Cartagena is at 3:00 p.m., with an estimated arrival at 4:15 p.m.

And how many people should I plan for? That way I can give you the exact price. 😊
